steps.en: After the 2nd letter, OCMS picks hirer notices that need a reminder
steps.id: Setelah 2nd letter, OCMS memilih notice hirer yang perlu reminder
steps.why_en: The reminder job is switched off in every environment and only runs when triggered by hand.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dimatikan di semua environment dan hanya jalan bila dipicu manual.

steps.en: OCMS checks the latest mobile number or email and saves it
steps.id: OCMS cek nomor mobile atau email terbaru lalu menyimpannya
steps.why_en: The latest-contact lookup is switched off in all environments; only the stored contact is used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan kontak terbaru dimatikan di semua environment; hanya kontak tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Notices with no usable mobile number or email are skipped
steps.id: Notice tanpa nomor mobile atau email yang bisa dipakai dilewati

steps.en: Hirers who opted out or have a passport get no electronic reminder
steps.id: Hirer yang opt-out atau ber-passport tidak dikirimi reminder elektronik
